decisions.reason: The reference-basis and adaptation changes are already fully represented by the candidate's existing message-51 MODIFY.
The instruction changes reference-driven script wording but does not change the target market or audience age range.
Discarding and rebuilding the script does not cancel or alter the requirement for an organic call to action.
The source identifies references for keyword extraction but does not alter the required product benefits or their source material.
The direct, strong, India-aligned hook requirement was already established in message 50; message 51 does not necessarily add or replace any hook attribute.
The script keyword-source change does not alter the Indian-only casting or male preference.
The source changes the script's reference use and does not change the required visual realism or UGC style.
The script replacement has no necessary effect on the color-grading or finishing standard.
Discarding the current script requires a replacement but does not change the freelancer's full-service production responsibility.
The source does not change the video count, duration, aspect ratios, or output scope.
The script keyword and reference changes do not resolve or alter the audio-level requirements or their ambiguity.
The instruction to rebuild the script around reference keywords does not change the required editing pace or cuts.
